finding: NYU Arabic Collections Online has a specific v.3 record for Maʻani al-Qurʼān (Cairo: Maṭbaʻat Dār al-Kutub al-Miṣrīyah, 1955; AUB provider; call no. BP130.4 .F3 1955). The record credits Farraʼ as author, Najati, al-Najjar, and al-Shalabi as annotators, and Ali al-Najdi Nasif as reviewer. Its low-resolution PDF is 38.77 MB; the available web reader refused the download because it exceeded its content limit. This improves the bibliographic candidate but does not verify printed p.377 or identify KSU's copy.
